notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Princess Remedy In A Heap of Trouble has been updated with the following tweaks:

+ Fixed a bug where music stopped looping after seeing the ending.
+ 360 controller d-pads should work now.
+ Fixed spelling errors.
+ Credits screen added.

- - - changes to the special bonus mode:
+ Pressing T outside of battle speeds up the game (a hidden sign informs of this).
+ There is a new battle behind the painting, but you can only enter if you have less than 12 hearts.

notes.title: Patch 1
notes.content:
Princess Remedy In A Heap of Trouble has been updated with the following tweaks:

+You can now hold Shift to slow Remedy's walking speed in Healing Mode.
+A sign tells you about slowing down in Healing Mode. Added a copy of this sign to Blister Beach.
+Boss 5 splits up properly after its first phase.
+Boss 5 fires less projectiles on Hard and DEATH mode.
+Boss 3 begins the battle by spawning 4 minions instead of 8.
+Improved the collision checking of the Injection ability.
+Fixed Lose and Win sounds being very loud during the ending.
